description.en: A Finnish university of technology, business and art near Helsinki. Non-EU/EEA bachelor students pay a yearly fee that depends on the field.
description.ru: Финский университет технологий, бизнеса и искусства рядом с Хельсинки. Студенты не из ЕС/ЕЭЗ платят ежегодный взнос, зависящий от направления.

notes_for_reviewer: Official aalto.fi page read 2026-10-06: for study rights beginning on or after 1 August 2025, non-EU/EEA bachelor tuition is EUR 12,000 per academic year (business and technology) and EUR 15,000 (art and architecture); a 25% reduction (EUR 9,000 / 11,250) applies to the first year if the offer is accepted and paid within 21 days; full scholarships remove the fee. I stored the business fee for ONE programme, International Business (found by title in a search result; I did not open its page, so duration, English as the teaching language, requirements and deadlines are unverified and left empty/assumed). Technology and design programmes are not collected. Aalto bachelor programmes are partly taught in Finnish.
